}}'''Zavion''' is the Lady of Gahaur and a member of [[Deira ni Ghaline t'Bashere|Deira Bashere's]] entourage.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Zavion}}

== Appearance ==
She is sinewy with red hair.

== Activities ==
While encamped in [[Andor]], Zavion defended Deira from two men who sought to ransack her tent and stab her.
